test.query: INSERT INTO codec_wallaby_seq_{type} (n) SELECT number/pi() FROM system.numbers LIMIT {num_rows} SETTINGS max_threads=1
INSERT INTO codec_wallaby_mon_{type} (n) SELECT number+sin(number) FROM system.numbers LIMIT {num_rows} SETTINGS max_threads=1
INSERT INTO codec_wallaby_rnd_{type} (n) SELECT (intHash64(number) - 4294967295)/pi() FROM system.numbers LIMIT {num_rows} SETTINGS max_threads=1
INSERT INTO codec_wallaby_rtn_{type} (n) SELECT round(number/20+sin(number), 3) FROM system.numbers LIMIT {num_rows} SETTINGS max_threads=1
